title: DyhrCoinflip
description: Very basic Coinflip plugin, with about 0.1% resource usage.
body:
# 🪙 DyhrCoinflip

A lightweight, straightforward Minecraft server plugin that allows players to engage in classic coinflip games. Perfect for adding a simple, risk-and-reward minigame to your economy or community server without any unnecessary bloat.

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Usage

The plugin is designed to be plug-and-play with a single, intuitive base command.

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/cf` | View all active coinflips currently available. |
| `/cf new <AMOUNT>` | Create a new coinflip with a specified wager. |
| `/cf about` | Display the current plugin version and information. |

---

## 🔐 Permissions

* **None needed!** By default, all players have access to all commands, making configuration completely hassle-free right out of the box.

---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the `DyhrCoinflip.jar` file.
2. Place the file into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart your server to load the plugin.
